name: Dawn of the Croods
description: The world's first family is back for more laughs as they discover sports, sleepovers and other wonders in a world of exotic creatures and adventures. This 2D animated cartoon is based on the 3D animated feature film, "The Croods".

videos.title: A Gran Day Out
videos.overview: When Gran moves into the cave with the Croods, she drives Grug nuts and embarrasses Eep in front of the first-ever group of cool kids.

videos.title: School of Hard Rocks
videos.overview: Eep loves to compete, so she teams up with her new friend Lerk and plans to win a school hunting exam, no matter what she has to do.

videos.title: Wet Hot Ahhh! Valley Summer
videos.overview: A dare contest makes Eep and Thunk do something crazy at the Watering Hole, and Ugga must overcome her fear of water to save them.

videos.title: Grug vs. the Moon
videos.overview: Grug starts a fight with the moon.

videos.title: This Means Warts
videos.overview: After snobby neighbors move in next door and complain about a bone pile blocking their backyard view, the Croods start the first prank war ever.

videos.title: The First Picture Show
videos.overview: Everyone loves it when Thunk uses shadow puppets to make the world's first movie ... until they see the end of the show.

videos.title: Caved & Confused
videos.overview: When Grug and Ugga go out on a date and leave the kids home alone, Eep throws the first-ever house party, which gets out of control.

videos.title: The Eep-Over
videos.overview: Eep invites her friends over for the first sleepover in history.

videos.title: Thunkytown
videos.overview: Thunk saves the day when wacky beasts invade.

videos.title: Mom Genes
videos.overview: Grug takes Ugga out to practice her hunting skills, but there are some kinds of animals that she just can't seem to catch.

videos.title: Garden of Eaten
videos.overview: When Eep becomes a veg-a-eat-ian, the family hunts for the biggest veggies they can find -- until something makes them go back to eating meat.

videos.title: Night of the Living Croods
videos.overview: Grug is called a zombie after taking the world's first nap.

videos.title: A Spoonful of Soo-gar
videos.overview: After the Croods taste a new food for the first time, they can't stop eating it.

videos.title: Friday Night Liyotes
videos.overview: Grug won't let Eep join his winning team, so she forms her own group to play in history's first sports event.

videos.title: The Crood Who Knew Too Much
videos.overview: An animal bite has a freaky effect on Grug.

videos.title: Scent of a Thunk
videos.overview: Because he is so stinky, Thunk pretends to be something that he really isn't.

videos.title: Unsolved MysterEep
videos.overview: When two things go missing in the middle of the night, Eep hunts for clues to solve the first mystery ever.

videos.title: Gran the Unfriendly Ghost
videos.overview: During a solar eclipse, Gran fakes her own death to teach her family a lesson.

videos.title: Bad Sandy
videos.overview: The Croods must tame Sandy's wild behavior or she'll get exiled.

videos.title: It Crushes
videos.overview: When Eep goes gaga over a new boy at school, the Croods try to cure her.

videos.title: Rebel Without a Paws
videos.overview: Thunk falls in with the wrong crowd, to his family's dismay.

videos.title: Grug vs. Math
videos.overview: Grug struggles to learn a hunting skill that requires brains rather than brawn.

videos.title: Footloss
videos.overview: When the adults ban dancing, the teens rebel with an underground club.

videos.title: The Good Surprise
videos.overview: To cure their mom's bad mood, Thunk and Eep learn how to surprise her in a good way.

videos.title: Night Mare on Eep Street
videos.overview: Eep hunts for an elusive night mare but finds the night crazies.

videos.title: What Screams May Come
videos.overview: Eep makes the scream-leading team and falls under her coach's influence.

videos.title: Grunt Anything
videos.overview: After neighbor Snoot's wife kicks him out, the Croods help him win her back.

videos.title: There Will Be Eggs
videos.overview: Eep and Thunk stumble upon a treasure trove of eggs and become rich -- and mistrustful of each other.

videos.title: I Think Were Alone Meow
videos.overview: Gran finds new friends just as crabby as she is.

videos.title: FrEepy Friday
videos.overview: After getting grounded (literally) for making mischief with her friends, Eep bets her father that he can't survive even one day as a teenager.

videos.title: Grug vs. Gurg
videos.overview: To get a break from his honey-do list, Grug has his doppelgänger fill in for him.

videos.title: Unfair Fair
videos.overview: Eep and Thunk try to sabotage a pair of cheaters' idea fair project.

videos.title: Baby Face Off
videos.overview: While Thunk baby-sits, Sandy gets blamed for trouble caused by a tiny new neighbor.

videos.title: The Pursuit of Wrinkliness
videos.overview: Worried Thunk is too soft to survive, Gran vows to toughen him up.

videos.title: Croodtopia
videos.overview: The valley's kids seize a chance to create a no-rules society.

videos.title: Hands on a Hard Egg
videos.overview: With a huge egg at stake, a contest is held to see who can hold onto it the longest.

videos.title: Disaster of Puppets
videos.overview: After inventing ventriloquism, Thunk gets jealous when his puppet upstages him.

videos.title: Love Will Eep Us Together
videos.overview: Banned from dating, Eep sets out to unite two buffalippos instead.

videos.title: The Tide Is Nigh
videos.overview: Eep becomes a death-guard at the watering hole, which proves less exciting than she thought.

videos.title: Rain Gran
videos.overview: Gran convinces everyone she can control the weather.

videos.title: Dawn of the Broods
videos.overview: On vacation, the Croods find a family living alone in a utopia too good to be true. The Croods must escape and warn Ahhh! Valley before it's too late.

videos.title: It Takes Ahhh! Valley
videos.overview: After finding their way out of a creature's stomach, the Croods head back to Ahhh! Valley to stop the Broods from taking over their homeland.

videos.title: Deus Ex Monkhuahua
videos.overview: While Grug has his first day as leader of Ahhh! Valley, a new family pet makes Sandy jealous.

videos.title: Slak Attack
videos.overview: Eep and Thunk try out a new lazy lifestyle.

videos.title: Gorgey Girl
videos.overview: Eep finds a mysterious pen pal to share her feelings with.

videos.title: A Gran Adventure
videos.overview: When Gran reveals she's hidden a treasure guarded by booby traps, Eep sets off to find it.

videos.title: 127 Owwws
videos.overview: While giving a lesson on self-reliance, Grug suffers a mishap that tests his will to survive.

videos.title: 28 Fleas Later
videos.overview: A plan to get revenge against the Broods backfires.

videos.title: To Squawk with Love
videos.overview: Squawk's students try to add some fun to his dreary life.

videos.title: Lerk Was the Night
videos.overview: When the Broods steal the valley's food supply, it's up to Eep and Lerk to get it back.

videos.title: The Flawed Couple
videos.overview: To help get all the valley's work done, Grug pairs up every adult with a child trainee.

videos.title: Go-Sip Girl
videos.overview: Ugga joins the "nitting" club, but has trouble fitting in.

videos.title: Munk History
videos.overview: When Munk reports his family missing, Grug takes it upon himself as valley leader to find them.

videos.title: Happy Howl Day
videos.overview: The residents of Ahhh! Valley celebrate Howl Day.

videos.title: Snooty and the Beasts
videos.overview: When the Big Chickuna invades the valley, all the residents evacuate to safety except for Bulk, whose rescue becomes a contest between Grug and Snoot.

videos.title: Zero Dark Thunky
videos.overview: While he and Eep are held captive by the Broods for a ransom, Thunk finds his soulmate.

videos.title: Pie vs. Pie
videos.overview: Ugga's popular meatzza business attracts a competitor: Amber.

videos.title: Super Smash Siblings
videos.overview: Eep realizes softy Thunk is the perfect partner for winning a cutthroat game.

videos.title: A Hole in Grug
videos.overview: Grug invents a sport he hopes will earn him a spot on the Wall of Fame.

videos.title: Bait with Destiny
videos.overview: Thunk demonstrates an unexpected talent that lands him a new job.

videos.title: Sappy Together
videos.overview: A sticky situation forces Grug to accept Gran as his hunting partner.

videos.title: Scare Tactics
videos.overview: Grug uses fear to get the residents to accept defense measures against the Broods.

videos.title: DisturbiAHHH!
videos.overview: While laid up with an injury, Eep witnesses a suspicious encounter.

videos.title: Thunk O'Clock High
videos.overview: A new liyote in the neighborhood targets Thunk for bullying.

videos.title: The Croo-gitive
videos.overview: When Grug is imprisoned for a crime he didn't commit, he must escape to clear his name.

videos.title: A Few Good Grugs
videos.overview: Accused of stealing the valley's food stash, the Croods are allowed a "try-all" to prove their innocence.

videos.title: A Valley Shine Day
videos.overview: Kevin gives Thunk tips on attracting girls.

videos.title: Chalk the Line
videos.overview: Eep tricks her parents into letting her go to a grown-up party.

videos.title: Weighting Is the Hardest Part
videos.overview: To win back the title of Hefty Hunter, Grug seeks the help of a personal trainer.

videos.title: Wrestlebabia: The Musical
videos.overview: Sandy expresses her frustrations about being treated like a baby by breaking into song.

videos.title: Flowers for Munk
videos.overview: Grug helps Munk get his job back with an IQ-boosting worm.

videos.title: They Might Be Sky Giants
videos.overview: While unconscious, Eep has a life-changing vision.

videos.title: The Grugest Story Ever Told
videos.overview: Afraid he's no longer respected as valley leader, Grug enlists Thunk to perform his life story.

videos.title: Worms of Endearment
videos.overview: Lerk's plan to save her worm playmates from becoming bait spirals out of control.

videos.title: Dr. StrangeGrug or How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Spear
videos.overview: Grug introduces his new invention to Ahhh! Valley: the spear.

videos.title: Tunnel of Terror
videos.overview: Eep drags her friends into Ahhh! Valley's Tunnel of Terror to see if it lives up to its name.

videos.title: Creature from the Crood Lagoon
videos.overview: A mysterious creature saves Thunk from drowning.

videos.title: Voice Fail
videos.overview: When Grug loses his commanding voice, he and Ugga search for it. Meanwhile, Eep gets carried away while acting as the valley leader's spokesperson.

videos.title: Punch-Thunk Love
videos.overview: After finding out Thunk is in love with Blurg Brood, Eep tries to interest him in a new girl.

videos.title: Nay Boors
videos.overview: Ugga attempts to drive away selfish neighbor Snoot.

videos.title: Caverns and Creepers
videos.overview: Eep's love of competition and destruction ruins Thunk's teamwork-based game.

videos.title: Rad Teacher
videos.overview: Squawk gets fired and is replaced by a very different kind of teacher.

videos.title: Grug's First Chance
videos.overview: Grug stumbles on an easy way to solve feuds as valley leader.

videos.title: Furry Road
videos.overview: Thunk narrates a documentary on one of Ahhh! Valley's many creatures: the bearowl.

videos.title: My Big Fat Gran Wedding
videos.overview: To win a bet, Gran decides to marry Mow.

videos.title: The Strutting Edge
videos.overview: Ahhh! Valley's kids compete in the Beasty Pageant to see who best poses, calls and struts like an animal.

videos.title: Can't Hardly Bait
videos.overview: To graduate with their pals, Thunk and Womp take Squawk's crash course.

videos.title: Crood Detente
videos.overview: Without asking the other residents, Grug makes a peace deal with the Broods.

videos.title: This Is an End
videos.overview: A fast-approaching asteroid headed toward Ahhh! Valley leads the residents to make hasty moving plans, but Grug insists he can defend their homeland.

country: United States, South Korea, Canada, Philippines
